If SdServerService is set to a state other than SD_SERVER_SERVICE_AVAILABLE ( via Sd_ServerServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStop() ) while being in Initial Wait Phase:  Enter the Down P hase .  Set a ll associated EventHandl er to SD_EVENT_HANDLER_RELEASED and report it to the BswM by calling the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState .  Cancle all relevant timers for service instance ( see SWS_SD_00318) .

If SdServerService is set to a state other than SD_SERVER_ SERVICE_AVAILABLE ( via Sd_ServerServiceSetState() or Sd_ServiceGroupStop() ) while being in Initial Wait Phase: • Enter the Down Phase. • Set all associated EventHandler to SD_EVENT_HANDLER_RELEASED and re- port it to the BswM by calling the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState. • Cancle all relevant timers for service instance (see SWS_SD_00318).
